title: 6730: Fix excluded dates ignored in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss date format in gantt diagram
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

When using a Gantt diagram with `dateFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'`, the `excludes` dates (like weekends or specific days) were not being correctly matched. This PR fixes the issue.

Resolves #6730
